aboutMe.summary: Nikhil Kaundal is a Full Stack Developer & Data Engineer currently completing B.E in Computer Science and Engineering at UIET Panjab University, Chandigarh (Class of 2026). Delivered RESTful APIs, automated data ingestion workflows, and KPI dashboards that reduced manual effort by ~40%. Combines full-stack development (React.js, Next.js 15, Node.js, Express.js, Supabase, MySQL) with data engineering (Flask, Python, ChromaDB, LlamaIndex, Power BI, ARIMA) and web content management. Completed an off-campus software trainee internship at Dystinction Technology on OkQuoted (a live B2B SaaS procurement platform), shipping 5+ production modules including multi-round negotiation systems, 3-layer RBAC, and KYC workflows. In addition to software engineering, he is an award-winning photographer (1st place at Spectrum fest, PEC Chandigarh) and led student media and social media teams (SAE India Media Lead, Goonj Social Media Head).
